question: Who is the author of the book titled 'The White Tiger'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aravind Adiga.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The White Tiger:-**

 
 
• It is a 2008 novel by Indian author Aravind Adiga.
 
• The novel is told from the perspective of Balram Halwai, a poor villager who rises to become a successful entrepreneur in Bangalore.
 
• 'The White Tiger' is a novel that explores the **dark side of India's economic boom** through the story of a driver who becomes an entrepreneur.
 
 
 
• **Aravind Adiga:-**
 
 
• He is an Indian writer and journalist. He was born in Madras, India, in 1974, and he currently lives in Mumbai.
 
• He is the author of three novels, The White Tiger (2008), Between the Assassinations (2009), and Last Man in Tower (2011).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mulk Raj Anand:-**

 
 
• He was an Indian writer and critic known for his novels and short stories that depicted the lives of the poor and oppressed in India.
 
• He is best known for his book** 'Untouchable'.**
 
 
 
• **Ravinder Singh:-**
 
 
• **​**He is an Indian author who has written several popular romance novels such as** 'I Too Had a Love Story' and 'Can Love Happen Twice?'.**
 
 
 
• **Khushwant Singh:-**
 
 
• He was an **Indian author, lawyer, diplomat, and journalist **who wrote several books on Indian history, culture, and politics.
 
• He is best known for his novel **'Train to Pakistan'. **
